gaps.statement: have x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x2 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x3 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x4 ∧ (↑x4 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x3) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), (x2.wires (List.ofFn x7)).getD ((42 : ℕ) + x3) Bool.false = Bool.true → x2.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => List.countP (fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn x4.op Bool.false Bool.true Bool.false (fun (x5 : ℕ) => Bool.false) Bool.false) x3.gates; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → x1 x4 → ∃ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x7 ∧ x1 x7 ∧ x2 x7 ∧ x3 x7 ≤ x3 x4

have x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x2 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x3 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x4 ∧ (↑x4 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x3) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∀ (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), (x2.wires (List.ofFn x7)).getD ((42 : ℕ) + x3) Bool.false = Bool.true → x2.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => List.countP (fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn x4.op Bool.false Bool.true Bool.false (fun (x5 : ℕ) => Bool.false) Bool.false) x3.gates; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → x1 x4 → x2 x4 → (104 : ℕ) ≤ x3 x4

∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → (∀ (x3 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x4 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x5 ∧ (↑x5 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x4) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x3 x4 = Bool.true ∧ x3 x5 = Bool.true) → ∃ (x4 : Finset (Finset (Fin (21 : ℕ)) × Finset (Fin (21 : ℕ)))), (∀ x5 ∈ x4, x5.1.Nonempty ∧ x5.2.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x7 ∈ x5.1, ∀ x9 ∈ x5.2, (↑x9 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x7) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ (∀ (x5 x6 : Fin (21 : ℕ)), (↑x6 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x5) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)] → ∃ x8 ∈ x4, x5 ∈ x8.1 ∧ x6 ∈ x8.2) ∧ ∑ x5 ∈ x4, (x5.1.card + x5.2.card - (1 : ℕ)) ≤ List.countP (fun (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn x5.op Bool.false Bool.true Bool.false (fun (x6 : ℕ) => Bool.false) Bool.false) x1.gates + (1 : ℕ)
